name: Still Becoming
thesis: A midnight-purple personal story, opening with monumental lowercase lettering and Monstrosity, then unfolding as a continuous illustrated reading spread.
interaction: Ordinary scrolling changes the sticky artwork and active chapter on desktop. Chapter links jump through the story; mobile places each illustration beside its own words.
why: Combines Objects of Obsession’s image-and-type layering, the purple personal corner, and an unfinished letter with substantive chapters about shop leadership, makerspace teaching, software, machines, and helping other Hack Club builders.
